summary: Restart an unavailable Pi pane against its exact existing conversation, taking the transcript over from any Pi still holding it.
trigger: daemon startup, axo.session.pi.restart.auto.v1 (app auto-restart), or axo.session.pi.restart.force.v2 (explicit user restart)

steps.action: under the catalog mutex: check pane is unavailable and not already recovering; reserve a recovery ID
require the Pi session file to be owned by exactly one Session row
outside the mutex: verify the history file exists and is Axo-owned (device/inode identity)
take over the transcript writer lock (flock)
properties: auto: ask Pi to shut down if idle, never force
force: escalate to signals aimed only at the verified Pi process group

steps.action: verify the history file did not change while waiting
briefly re-take the mutex: confirm reservation is current, rotate the bridge token
spawn Pi outside the mutex, inheriting the writer lock
commit only if the reservation is still current; otherwise stop the new child outside the mutex
start the Pi bridge worker, publish session.snapshot
